_source: Live Devin CLI 3000.11.92 (swe-1-6-slow), a private tmux server, 2026-10-20 (#448): a hook wrapper that logged each hook run before running the plugin's hook, and a log of the broker's /mcp and /mcp/event requests. The session had joined a room and sat in a wait(room, 100) loop.

cases.how: tmux kill-session: SIGHUP to the pane's process group (devin and its child devin acp)
cases.open_wait_request: ended with the processes: the client's connection dropped 49 s into a wait of up to 100 s
cases.participant_after_the_kill: still busy (status_src hook:PostToolUse) with no wait open, 70 s later, and for as long as it was watched
cases.with_the_fix: offline (status_src wait:dropped) 130 s after the drop

cases.how: kill -TERM of the devin process (the interactive one)
cases.open_wait_request: ended with the processes: the connection dropped 39 s into the wait
cases.participant_after_the_kill: still busy (status_src hook:PostToolUse) with no wait open
cases.with_the_fix: offline (status_src wait:dropped) 130 s after the drop

cases.how: /exit typed at an idle prompt: a normal quit
cases.participant_after_the_quit: offline at once, by that hook (the existing SessionEnd path)
